initialization: Same four charged exact routes and all associated observations. Overrides native starting policies for controlled comparison.
cherrypick_mapping: Section 3.5 GP Matern5/2, EI times feasibility, relative EI stopping. Replace price objective with -U, machine configuration with shared five-variable deployment/route encoding; feasibility is known capability/memory/capacity, so its probability is an exact 0/1 mask. Scalar length scale fitted by bounded marginal likelihood, acquisition maximized over fresh Sobol plus local samples. Not original Spearmint implementation.
proteus_mapping: Section 4 joint binary model allocation and continuous query assignment MILP with profiled capacities. One physical GPU represented by memory-constrained model/replica states, shared mixed-task capacity enforced. Q retains quality objective; U-linear substitutes a linear ridge surrogate trained only on common initialization. Both solve one plan, then validate through common oracle; no invented restart or local search.
comparability: Common final measured U and upper budgets; Proteus-Q optimizes a different objective, so it is a contextual baseline, not same-objective proof. Proteus-U-linear optimizes a learned approximation, not exact nonlinear U. Native early stops retained, no forced budget spending.
schedule: Fixed shuffled same-process batch, one BLAS thread; no tuning, reruns or additional seeds after observing results.
evidence: Existing synthetic convex queue-cost benchmark; not actual FIFO/GPU or a reproduction of either paper's full system.
